afterDefects: Muted, dusty pinkish-tan palette with somewhat low overall contrast. The court reads well, the crowd is dense and colourful, and the players are clear.

The sand lighting is fairly flat and slightly washed out, so the court is desaturated and the lines have weak contrast. The opponent's reflection ghosts into the court, and there is a large empty sand area in the foreground. Even so, the crowd, signage and theme give it much more life.
Beach theme reads only as a flat pinkish-tan floor; overall a bit desaturated and low-contrast; the shadow under the player is faint and the near-court lighting is uneven
The background tower prop looks ghostly and semi-transparent at the top, and the orange is quite saturated. Otherwise the warm lighting, long shadows, full crowd and readable players are strong.
The background stadium is blurry and low-detail. The opponent overlaps the 'AURA SLAM' sign, and faint score text ghosts onto the court. The camera is far out, so the players are small.

The whole frame is near-monochrome orange, so the court and surround merge somewhat; the background tower is blurry and looks pasted on; the distant player is small at this camera distance; the crowd stands are dense but repetitive
A slightly harsh vignette and green floor glow at the sides, and a faint shadow ghost under the far player. Otherwise there is good contrast, a full crowd and a clearly readable court.
The corners have a slightly greenish murk, the opponent casts a faint reflection or ghost, and the bright spotlight hotspots at the edges are a little blotchy.
Bright spotlight hotspots wash out the stands at the lower left and right; the teal surround is slightly muddy; minor patterned texture shimmer on the court

The frame is somewhat washed out, with a low-contrast pale palette and a teal court with weak separation. The background tower is semi-transparent and ghostly. Still, it is clearly a themed scene with a full crowd and readable players.
Overall beige haze makes it washed out and low in contrast. The pale teal court blends into the sand, the distant stadium is a faded, blurry backdrop, and the players are small.
Pale, low-contrast palette; the sky and sand look somewhat washed out; the background tower is hazy and looks pasted on; the players are small; the teal court is slightly muted against the beige
The background tower is slightly ghostly, and the far player overlaps the 'AURA SLAM' banner. Otherwise the green palette is cohesive, the shadows are good and the crowd is full.
